_comment:
Model profiles and seats for delegate.ps1. Every run goes through the Cursor CLI. Models are always pinned: Cursor's default is 'auto' and it offers Claude models, so an unpinned worker could silently use Claude (both are blocked below). profiles.

.model is the worker or reviewer model; council runs pick profiles.council.seats. with -Seat; -Model overrides either. seats.readiness and seats.judgement are read by feature.ps1 for review lenses (judgement[0] is Grok, [1] is GLM). Check model ids with: agent --list-models

agy.reason: T0: Antigravity FAQ forbids wrapping agy in third-party agents on consumer plans
